# `intercompany-mapping` commands

## `intercompany-mapping set`

Save an immutable local due-to/due-from mapping revision for an authorized counterpart. Requires management in both companies. Accounts must be unused and home-currency. This reserves only local accounts; it does not activate a relationship or post money. Configure each company, then intercompany-relationship create.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | intercompany.manage |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/intercompany-mapping.set` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow intercompany-mapping set --peer 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --due-from 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAW --due-to 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAX --expected-version 0 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Prepare local intercompany work" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "intercompany-mapping set", "input": {"peer": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV", "due_from": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAW", "due_to": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAX", "expected_version": 0}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `peer` | `--peer` | string | yes | no | — | Registered counterpart company ID; names are not selectors.; minimum length 26; maximum length 26 |
| `due_from` | `--due-from` | string | yes | no | — | Local unused active other-current-asset account ID.; minimum length 26; maximum length 26 |
| `due_to` | `--due-to` | string | yes | no | — | Local unused active other-current-liability account ID.; minimum length 26; maximum length 26 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer | yes | no | — | Latest local mapping version; zero for first setup.; minimum 0 |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/intercompany-mapping.set`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |
